problem_severity.evidence: Data teams cite pipeline failures as top pain; bad data reaching dashboards erodes trust; on-call burden is real

demand_signals.evidence: Active data engineering communities (dbt Slack 50K+, r/dataengineering); strong conference interest; 'data observability' trending

competitive_intensity.evidence: Monte Carlo, Bigeye, Atlan are funded and established; open source alternatives (Great Expectations) exist

market_size.evidence: Data observability market ~$1B; modern data stack growing 20%+ CAGR; mid-market underserved by enterprise tools

execution_difficulty.evidence: Many integrations required (Airflow, dbt, Fivetran, etc.); ML for anomaly detection; data security concerns

gtm_viability.evidence: Data engineers reachable via dbt Slack, Twitter, newsletters (Data Council); product-led possible; conference presence valuable

timing.evidence: Modern data stack adoption accelerating; data teams expanding; enterprise tools too expensive for mid-market creating gap

recommendation.rationale: Strong market with clear mid-market gap between expensive enterprise tools (Monte Carlo) and complex open source (Great Expectations). Timing favorable with modern data stack adoption. Key is differentiated positioning on simplicity/no-code and usage-based pricing.
next_steps: Build MVP with 3 key integrations (dbt, Airflow, Snowflake)
Establish presence in dbt Slack and data engineering communities
